مُسْتَقِيم mustaqım [quasi-act. part.] straight, upright, righteous

(46:30) يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَى طَرِيقٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ guiding to the truth and to a straight path.

entries.label: أَقَامَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَقَامَ ʾaqāma [v. IV, trans.]

1 to prop up, to erect, to support

(18:77) فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ ‏‏and they found a wall in it that was on the point of collapsing [lit. wanting to collapse] so then he set it up (or, supported it); *

(30:30) فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفاً devote yourself entirely [lit. set up your face] to the religion

2 to observe, to maintain

(9:11) فَإِنْ تَابُوا وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاَةَ if they turn to God and maintain the prayer ‏

3 to arrange, to organise, to set up, to conduct

(4:102) وَإِذَا كُنْتَ فِيهِمْ فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ الصَّلاَةَ when you [Prophet] are with them, and you conduct the prayer for them ‏

4 to institute, to keep up, to maintain

(11:114) وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ and keep up the prayer at both ends of the day, and during parts of the night ‏

5 to abide by, to stand by, to uphold

(5:66) وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَقَامُوا التَّوْرَاةَ وَالإِنْجِيلَ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ if they had upheld the Torah and the Gospel and what was sent down to them from their Lord ‏‏

6 to straighten, to establish, to perform in an upright manner

(65:2) وَأَقِيمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ and give witness [correctly] for the sake of God

7 to assign to

(18:105) فَلاَ نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا We will not hold any weighing for them [their deeds], on the Day of Resurrection (or, We shall not assign any weight to them on the Day of Resurrection).

entries.label: أَقْوَم
entries.definitionHtml:
أَقْوَم ʾaqwam [elat.]

1 more/most upright

(2:282) ذَلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَادَةِ this way is more equitable in God’s eyes, and more reliable as testimony‏

2 more/most precise

(73:6) إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلا night worshipping is most taxing [on those who conduct it] (or, makes a deeper impression) but far reaching in prayer [lit. speech].

entries.label: إِقَام
entries.definitionHtml:
إِقَام ʾiqām (= إِقَامَة ʾiqāmatun) [v. n. of v. IV, trans. (with the final ة elided as means of directing attention to the context in which the word appears)] act of observing, maintaining, upholding

(21:73) وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَإِقَامَ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِيتَاءَ الزَّكَاةِ and We inspired in them the doing of good, the upholding of prayer and the giving of alms‏.

entries.label: إِقَامَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
إِقَامَةٌ ʾiqāmatun [v. n. of v. IV] act of staying

(16:80) وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ جُلُودِ الأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ and He provided for you, from the hides of cattle, [houses] tents [that] you find light on the day you travel and on the day you settle down.

entries.label: القِيّامَةِ
entries.definitionHtml:
القِيّامَةِ ʾal-qiyāmatu [n.] the rising, the resurrection *

(19:95) يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَة the Day of Resurrection; * القِيّامَةِ name of Sura 75, Meccan sura, so-named because of the reference in verse

1 to the ‘Resurrection’.

entries.label: اِسْتَقَامَ
entries.definitionHtml:
اِسْتَقَامَ ʾistaqāma [v. X, intrans.] to go straight, to become upright, to follow the correct path

(46:13) إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا those who say, ‘Our lord is God,’ and then become upright; ‏‏*

(9:7) فَمَا اسْتَقَامُوا لَكُمْ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا لَهُمْ so long as they remain true to you be true to them.

entries.label: تَقْوِيم
entries.definitionHtml:
تَقْوِيم taqwım [v. n. of v. II; n.] forming, moulding; stature

(95:4) لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الإِنْسَانَ فِى أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ and indeed, We fashioned humankind in the best of statures.

entries.label: قَائِم
entries.definitionHtml:
قَائِم qāʾim I [act. part.; pl. قَائِمُون qāʾimūn]

1 one standing

(3:39) فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فِى الْمِحْرَابِ so the angels called out to him, while he stood praying in the sanctuary‏ ‏

2 watching, observing

(13:33) أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَى كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ is He who is aware of the actions of every soul [as he who is aware of nothing?] ‏‏

3 one being constant at

(3:75) وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ إِنْ تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لاَ يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ إِلاَّ مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَائِمًا but of them is he who, if you trust him [over] with a [single] dinar, will not return it to you, unless you persist in standing over him

4 that which is taking place, coming true

(18:36) وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً I do not think the Hour will take place

5 supporting, upholding

(3:18) شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَأُولُو الْعِلْمِ قَائِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ God bears witness, that there is no god but He, as do the angels and those imbued with knowledge, upholding justice ‏II [quasi-act. part.] upright

(3:113) مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ أُمَّةٌ قَائِمَةٌ يَتْلُونَ ءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ ءَانَاءَ اللَّيْلِ among the People of the Book there is an upright group who recite God’s revelations throughout the night.

entries.label: قَامَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قَامَ qāma ū [v. intrans.]

1 to stand up

(4:142) وَإِذَا قَامُوا إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ قَامُوا كُسَالَى when they stand up to pray, they do so sluggishly

2 to shoulder or undertake a difficult/great task, to assume [a big responsibility]

(74:1–2) يَاأَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ‏ you, wrapped up in your cloak [and lying down], assume your responsiblity and warn [all]

3 to rise from the dead

(2:275) الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ الرِّبَا لاَ يَقُومُونَ إِلاَّ كَمَا يَقُومُ الَّذِي يَتَخَبَّطُهُ الشَّيْطَانُ مِنَ الْمَسِّ those who take usury will [not] rise [on the Day of Resurrection] except like one scourged by Satan’s touch

4 to be about to act, to undertake

(5:6) يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرَافِقِ you who believe, when you are about to pray, wash your faces and your hands up to [also interpreted as: including] the elbows

5 to stop, to halt, to stand still

(2:20) كُلَّمَا أَضَاءَ لَهُمْ مَشَوْا فِيهِ وَإِذَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا whenever it flashes on them they walk on in it and when it darkens around them they stand still‏‏‏ ‏

6 to stand in for, to be in the place of

(5:107) فَآخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا two others [should] stand in for them

7 [with prep. على] to stand over

(9:84) وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا وَلاَ تَقُمْ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ and never pray over any of them who die, and never stand over his grave ‏

8 to depart from, to rise from

(27:39) أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مِنْ مَقَامِكَ I will bring it to you before you rise from your place ‏

9 to worship, to pray

(9:108) لاَ تَقُمْ فِيهِ أَبَدًا لَمَسْجِدٌ أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَى مِنْ أَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ أَحَقُّ أَنْ تَقُومَ فِيهِ ‏never worship in it–a mosque founded from the first day on consciousness of God is a more fitting place in which you worship

10 to function, to exist

(30:25) وَمِنْ ءَايَاتِهِ أَنْ تَقُومَ السَّمَاءُ وَالأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِ and [one] of His wonders, is that the heavens and the earth function by His command ‏

11 to take place, to come to be held

(14:41) رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ Lord, forgive me, and my parents and the believers, on the Day when the Reckoning is held ‏

12 to discharge one’s duties, to undertake a task, maintain/establish

(4:127) وَأَنْ تَقُومُوا لِلْيَتَامَى بِالْقِسْطِ and that you discharge your duties towards the orphans in fairness ‏

13 to object to, to rebel

(18:14) وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا فَقَالُوا رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ لَنْ نَدْعُوَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِلَهًا لَقَدْ قُلْنَا إِذًا شَطَطًا We braced their hearts when they rebelled and said, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth; we will never call upon any god other than Him, for that would be an outrageous thing to say.’

entries.label: قَوّامَا
entries.definitionHtml:
قَوّامَا qawāma [n.] straightness, correct balance

(25:67) وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنْفَقُوا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ قَوَّامًا and there are those who, when they spend, they neither waste nor are stingy, but keep between these to a just balance.

entries.label: قَوَّامُون
entries.definitionHtml:
قَوَّامُون qawwāmūn [pl. of intens. act. part. قَوَّام qawwām]

1 those who are most upright, those who are steadfast, guardians

(4:135) كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ بِالْقِسْطِ شُهَدَاءَ لِلَّهِ be upholders of justice and bear witness for God ‏

2 those who are responsible for, take care of, in charge of

(4:34) الرِّجَالُ قَوَّامُونَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ بِمَا فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ وَبِمَا أَنْفَقُوا مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ men are in charge of women by virtue of what God has bestowed on some of them in preference to others and by the spending of their money [on women].

entries.label: قَوْم
entries.definitionHtml:
قَوْم qawm [coll. n.]

1 a people

(13:11) إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّى يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ God does not change the condition of a people unless they change what is in themselves

2 a specified group of people

(7:59) لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ We sent Noah to his people; he said, ‘My people, worship God’

3 [with the definite article الْقَوْمِ ʾal‐qawm] a certain people

(4:104) وَلاَ تَهِنُوا فِى ابْتِغَاءِ الْقَوْمِ إِنْ تَكُونُوا تَأْلَمُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَأْلَمُونَ كَمَا تَأْلَمُونَ and do not be faint-hearted in pursuing [those people] the enemy: for if you are suffering hardship then they, too, are suffering

4 ones, individuals, anyone

(49:11) لاَ يَسْخَرْ قَومٌ مِنْ قَوْمٍ عَسَى أَنْ يَكُونُوا خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ no men [no individuals] should jeer at others; as they may [after all] be better than them.

entries.label: قَيُّوم
entries.definitionHtml:
قَيُّوم qayyūm [intens. act. part.] constant, eternal, guardian, benefactor *

(2:255) الْقَيُّوم[an attribute of God] the Supporter [of all], the Constant, the Everlasting, the Independent. ‏

entries.label: قَيِّم
entries.definitionHtml:
قَيِّم qayyim [quasi-act. part.] straight, true

(12:40) ذَلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ that is the true faith.‏

entries.label: قِيَام
entries.definitionHtml:
قِيَام qiyām I [v. n.]

1 rising, standing up

(51:45) فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مِنْ قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنْتَصِرِينَ they could not manage to stand and never were they able to defend themselves

2 supporting, providing security, a standard

(5:97) جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الْكَعْبَةَ الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ قِيَامًا لِلنَّاسِ God has made the Ka‘ba–the Sacred House–a standard for humankind ‏II [v. n.; n.] support, mainstay, livelihood

(4:5) وَلاَ تُؤْتُوا السُّفَهَاءَ أَمْوَالَكُمُ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِيَامًا and do not entrust to the feeble-minded your property (or, the properties of the feeble-minded) over which God has assigned to you responsibilty III [pl. of act. part. قَائِم qāʾim] those who are standing up, those who are rising up

(39:68) ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَى فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنْظُرُونَ then it is blown another [time] and, behold, they are standing, looking on.

entries.label: قِيَم
entries.definitionHtml:
قِيَم qiyam [quasi-act. part.] true, straight, upright

(6:161) إِنَّنِي هَدَانِي رَبِّي إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ دِينًا قِيَمًا my Lord has guided me to a straight path, an upright religion.

entries.label: مَقَام
entries.definitionHtml:
مَقَام maqām I [v. n.] staying

(10:71) إِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَقَامِي وَتَذْكِيرِي بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ if my staying among you and my reminding [you] of God’s signs are burdensome on you II [n. of place]

1 physical place, location

(2:125) وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى and take the spot where Abraham stood as a place of prayer

2 seat, seating place

(27:39) أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مِنْ مَقَامِكَ I will bring it to you before you rise from your seat‏

3 rank, position, status

(37:164) وَمَا مِنَّا إِلاَّ لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَعْلُومٌ there is not a single one of us but has a known rank; *‏

(5:107) فَآخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا two others [should] replace them (or, stand in their place)

4 situation, abode, dwelling

(26:58) وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ treasures and a noble dwelling.

entries.label: مُقَام
entries.definitionHtml:
مُقَام muqām [n. of place]

1 place; stand

(33:13) يَاأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لاَ مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوا people of Yathrib, there is no place for you [among the defending army], so go back! ‏

2 abode, position

(25:76) خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا abiding there forever–fair it is as a station and abode.

entries.label: مُقَامَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُقَامَةٌ muqāmatun [n. of place; v. n.] place, abode of permanence; act of staying

(35:35) الَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ He who has, from His bounty, settled us in the home of permanence.

entries.label: مُقِيم
entries.definitionHtml:
مُقِيم muqım [quasi-act. part; pl. مُقِيمُون muqımūn]

1 one who is/that which is lasting, constant

(9:21) لَهُمْ فِيهَا نَعِيمٌ مُقِيمٌ in which they will have lasting bliss ‏

2 one who observes, maintains, upholds

(14:40) رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلاَةِ my Lord, make me constant in performing the prayer

3 that which is straight; lasting

(15:76) وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ indeed, they [the towns of the people of Lot and Midian] are on a highway [till now] remaining.
